games.name: ARC Raiders
games.blurb: Early game: learn the systems, keep the stash for what the workshop needs, and get the benches and skills going.

tasks.text: Check what each bench upgrade needs and keep only those materials
tasks.note: Some items marked recyclable are bench upgrade parts. Sell or recycle the rest to free the stash.
Quest blueprints are guaranteed, and quests give the XP that pays for skill points.

tasks.text: Build the last 2 or 3 workshop benches
Spend skill points on stamina in the Mobility tree
tasks.note: Names come from guides, so check them against the in-game tree.

tasks.text: Take In-Round Crafting in the Survival tree

tasks.note: Early on, coins go to stash space before anything else.
